## MCU Films Data {.unnumbered}


### Description

Data on Marvel Cinematic Universe films through the Infinity Saga,
including box office performance and Rotten Tomatoes scores.
Source is openintro package



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>mcu
</code></pre>


### Format

A data frame with variables:


<dl>
<dt>movie</dt><dd>Title of the movie
</dd>
<dt>length_hrs</dt><dd>Movie length: hours portion
</dd>
<dt>length_min</dt><dd>Movie length: minutes portion
</dd>
<dt>release_date</dt><dd>US release date
</dd>
<dt>opening_weekend_us</dt><dd>Opening weekend US box office (unadjusted)
</dd>
<dt>gross_us</dt><dd>Total US box office (unadjusted)
</dd>
<dt>gross_world</dt><dd>Total worldwide box office (unadjusted)
</dd>
<dt>phase</dt><dd>MCU Phase: 1, 2, or 3
</dd>
<dt>critics</dt><dd>RT critics score (0-100)
</dd>
<dt>audience</dt><dd>RT audience score (0-100)
</dd>
<dt>favor</dt><dd>Whether critics (1) or audience (2) score is higher
</dd>
</dl>



### Source

Internet Movie Database
